title: Prism Legend
description: Legend configuration for a mark-property channel.

legend.description: Legend options. Null suppresses the legend entirely; omitting the `legend` key instead keeps the default legend.

orient.description: Legend anchor. The four side values reserve margin next to the plot; the four corner values overlay the plot; none hides the legend (an alias for `"legend": null`, which is the canonical form).

title.description: Legend title. A string replaces the title derived from the bound field; false suppresses it. Same string-or-false convention as axis.title.

format.description: d3-format specifier applied to legend labels — gradient stop labels, and symbol labels whose category reads as a number. Same subset as axis.format and channel.format (see encode/format).

tick_count.description: Number of labelled stops a gradient legend draws (default 5). 1 labels the domain minimum alone; 0 leaves a bare bar.

values.description: Explicit legend entries. On a symbol legend it selects and reorders the categories shown, each keeping its own swatch colour; on a gradient legend it pins the labelled stops. Values matching no category (or falling outside the gradient domain) are dropped.

symbol_type.description: Symbol shape used by symbol legends.

padding.description: Interior padding in pixels: grows the legend frame on every side and insets its content by the same amount.

offset.description: Gap in pixels between the legend and the plot's chrome for a side orient, or the inward inset from the plot corner for a corner orient.

label_limit.description: Maximum label width in pixels. Longer labels are truncated with an ellipsis, and the legend box narrows or widens to the budget. 0 (the default) means unlimited.
